summary: Creating a job template: Automation Execution > Templates > Create template > Create job template. Prompt on launch asks for a field's value at launch and usually overrides the template; Job type Run executes the playbook while Check does a dry run, and an inventory needs permission granted by an administrator.
questions: How do I create a job template in AAP 2.6?
What is the difference between Run and Check job types?
What does Prompt on launch do?
